result:
Both of my sub-tasks are merged and CD finished green. I didn't open the deployed billing bundle, so "live" rests on the pipeline results.

- **PLAT-104-1, PR #1:** `billingUrl` in `libs/shared-contracts/index.js` is now `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`. This library lives in the repo and is inlined into the apps at build time. So there was no registry publish and no dependency bump, and I didn't bump its version. Merging it deployed nothing, because CD only watches `apps/core-shell/` and `apps/sub-route-billing/`.
- **PLAT-104-2, PR #2:** I bumped `sub-route-billing` to 1.0.1 in `package.json` and `package-lock.json`. That change under `apps/` is what makes CD rebuild and deploy billing. A local build of the app contained `billing/v2` before I opened the PR.

**Coordination:** after PR #1 merged, I messaged dev-b with the commit and the CD detail above. Their apps also need a real change inside their own directories to deploy. I sent no other messages and got no replies.

**Surprises:**
- The sub-task text implied a registry release, but the contributing guide's release rule applies only to libraries in their own repos.
- `st pr open --help` errored instead of printing help.
- Assumption: a version bump is an acceptable minimal trigger, since the apps' source didn't otherwise need to change.
